name: textpad
description: Compose and edit content in a line-addressed buffer, then send it to a target.

textpadId.description: Textpad ID from create (required for every operation except create and list).

content.description: Text to add. Multi-line content is split on newlines (create, insert_lines, append_lines, replace_lines).

target.description: create: an object describing where the buffer goes, whose `type` names the send target. send: the send target name (workspace).

endLine.description: 1-based last line, inclusive (view, replace_lines, remove_lines, copy_lines).

afterLine.description: Insert after this line; 0 prepends (insert_lines, copy_lines, attach).

path.description: JSON path such as $.items[0].name (json_get, json_set, json_delete, json_insert).

value.description: Value to set or insert (json_set, json_insert).

source.description: Where to attach or import from (attach, import).

keep.description: Keep the buffer after a successful send (send).

name: manage_workspace
description: List, read, write, delete, mkdir, or move files in the workspace directory.

path.description: Workspace-relative path (read, write, delete, mkdir, move; optional subdirectory for list).

name: manage_accounts
description: List, authenticate, check, refresh, rescope, or remove accounts.

operation.description: list: show accounts. authenticate: add an account through the browser. status: token and scopes. refresh: fetch a fresh token. scopes: re-authorize with a different service list. remove: delete the account and its credential.

email.description: Account identifier (required for status, refresh, scopes, remove).

access.description: 'read' asks for read-only scopes where the provider offers them (authenticate, scopes).

services.description: Services to authorize (scopes; optional for authenticate, default all).

confirmWriteAccess.description: Accept that some services stay writable when read-only was requested (authenticate, scopes).

category.description: Label for the account, e.g. personal or work (authenticate).

operation.description: list: list notes | get: read one note | create: create a note

name: queue_operations
description: Run several operations in order in one call, with $N.field references between them.

operations.description: Ordered list of operations to execute (max 16).

args.description: Arguments for the tool call. Use $N.field to reference a value from operation N (e.g. $0.id).

onError.description: bail (default): stop the queue at this failure. continue: record the error and proceed.

detail.description: summary (default): one line per operation. full: complete output of each operation.
